cases.description: A Position created with an entry trade of type BUY should return BUY from getStartingType().
A Position created with an entry trade of type SELL should return SELL from getStartingType().

If a Position is constructed without a valid entry trade (e.g., null entry), getStartingType() should throw an IllegalStateException (or behave according to the actual implementation). This case verifies the method’s defensive behavior when the internal state is inconsistent.
A Position created with an entry trade of type BUY and later closed with a SELL trade must still return BUY from getStartingType().
A Position created with an entry trade of type SELL and later closed with a BUY trade must still return SELL from getStartingType().
Calling getStartingType() multiple times on the same Position must consistently return the same value (BUY).
Calling getStartingType() multiple times on the same Position must consistently return the same value (SELL).
After a Position with starting type BUY is serialized and then deserialized, getStartingType() must still return BUY.
After a Position with starting type SELL is serialized and then deserialized, getStartingType() must still return SELL.
Invoking other Position methods (e.g., getGrossProfit(), isClosed()) must not affect the value returned by getStartingType(). The method should always return BUY for this Position.
Invoking other Position methods (e.g., getHoldingCost(), getProfit()) must not affect the value returned by getStartingType(). The method should always return SELL for this Position.
